question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "neither" i**s used to indicate that none of the options or actions mentioned were taken.
 
• In the context of this passage, **"neither"** complements the structure of the sentence, indicating that the correct measures were not taken.
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and 4 are grammatically incorrect in this context.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**The correct sentence from the passage is:** "*We should either have prepared ourselves to resist China ***or*** to make concessions, including border adjustments. We did ***neither__***. After 1956 we would not.............."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "either"** is incorrect because it would not fit in the structure of saying both options were not pursued.
 
• **Option 2: "pretty much"** is incorrect as it does not express the idea of complete inaction regarding both options.
 
• **Option 4: "not much"** is incorrect as it does not convey the idea of failure to pursue the necessary actions.
